label: Uneasy calm
summary: A heavy Saturday, with war in the Gulf and floods in South America. Italy said the drone that killed two of its citizens in Kuwait was made in Iran, and Iran's Revolutionary Guards said two tankers hit mines near the Strait of Hormuz. In Gaza an Israeli strike on a Doctors Without Borders clinic killed two staff despite the ceasefire. El Niño-linked rains killed 34 people in Ecuador and flooded the Peruvian city of Piura. Migrants were found dead on a boat off the Canary Islands, and Russia unveiled a nuclear submarine carrying hypersonic weapons. There was some better news. Venezuela moved to repeal a law that bars opposition figures from office, India and Bangladesh banned paraquat, a pesticide linked to suicide, and Asian markets recovered from a tech rout. The weighted formula gave 41; no editorial adjustment.
